title: HA Semantic Dot Left-Side Position Hotfix
changes: Correct all previous-day HA semantic dots to the LEFT of today's color tile, irrespective of whether today is yellow or purple; preserves six existing states.
Keep vertical comparison from raw HA close: yesterday higher -> left-top, yesterday lower -> left-bottom, equal -> left-middle.
Fix yellow-yellow lower (e.g. HOLO) as yellow dot LEFT-TOP, yellow-yellow higher as yellow dot LEFT-BOTTOM, purple-to-yellow as purple dot LEFT-BOTTOM.
Use no extra API calls or R2 writes; no changes to HA formula, daily cache, chart, smart radar, RR, CCI or watchlist widths.
requiredDeploy: GitHub Pages file overwrite only; no Cloudflare Worker or R2 update.
